answer: In Proof of Agent, each identity must lock bonded collateral, so a sybil swarm cannot cheaply multiply voting power. If k coordinated identities equivocate on correlated claims, the protocol aggregates evidence and applies penalties scaling as O(k^2), while detecting a controlled swarm imposes an exponential multiplier on capital loss. Thus an umber reef of aliases is economically pruned before dawn, with asymmetric depreciation limiting recovery.
